correctness.rationale: A fourteen-arc bitmask enumeration yields exactly 280 faces and a complete 834-incidence face poset. The deterministic matching pairs 134 cells and leaves precisely one critical 0-cell, five 2-cells, six 3-cells; a topological sort verifies global acyclicity. The signed integral Morse projection computed from all actual face boundaries makes every 3-to-2 critical differential exactly zero. By the simply connected two-skeleton and Hurewicz, each 3-cell attaches nullhomotopically. Independent full complex mod-two ranks agree. All proof-critical nonstandard calculations were replayed by the standalone verifier.

value.rationale: The length-(2,2,3) theta is the smallest uneven three-path theta, a one-edge subdivision of K_{2,3}, combining two overlapping cycles and two branching vertices. Its integral mixed-dimensional homotopy classification tests how bidirected multipath topology extends from single paths/polygons to interacting cycles and supplies reusable complete Morse data. This is a natural finite boundary case, not an arbitrary parameter slice or an Euler-characteristic recomputation.
